summary: Świecie County is a powiat (county-level unit of local government) in Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship in north-central Poland. It was created on January 1, 1999, under the Polish local government reforms passed in 1998. Its seat and largest town is Świecie, north of Toruń and north-east of Bydgoszcz, and its only other town is Nowe, north-east of Świecie.
one_line: Świecie County is a 1999-established powiat in Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland, seated in the town of Świecie.
key_facts: Świecie County is a powiat, a unit of territorial administration and local government, in Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship.
Świecie County is located in north-central Poland.
Świecie County came into being on January 1, 1999.
The creation of Świecie County resulted from the Polish local government reforms passed in 1998.
The administrative seat of Świecie County is the town of Świecie.
Świecie is the largest town in Świecie County.
Nowe is the only other town in Świecie County.
